lines.platformer3d.sign.1: THREE STARS ARE HIDDEN ON THE COURSE.
lines.platformer3d.sign.2: THE FLAG IS FAR TO THE NORTH. GOOD LUCK!

notes.platformer3d.boot: A step on the loading screen while the game builds the course of grass islands.
notes.platformer3d.hud.stars: The stars found of the three hidden ones, as 1/3.
notes.platformer3d.note.star: A hidden star just found: the first, second or third of three.
notes.platformer3d.note.checkpoint: A checkpoint flag reached: a fall now starts again here.
notes.platformer3d.sign.1: A signpost at the start: the first of its two rows (the box is about 40 letters wide).
notes.platformer3d.sign.2: The signpost's second row. The goal flag is at the far (north) end of the course.
notes.platformer3d.hint.jump: A button prompt's word, after the key ("Space jump (twice: double)"): press it again in the air for a double jump.
notes.platformer3d.hint.dash: A button prompt's word, after the key: dash.
notes.platformer3d.hint.camera: A button prompt's word, after the key: change the camera.
notes.platformer3d.over.won: The title over the end screen when the goal flag is reached.
notes.platformer3d.over.time: The time the course took: {time} in seconds (12.5), S for seconds.
notes.platformer3d.over.lost: The end screen after the last heart is lost.

brief: The 3D platformer slice: a sunny course of grass islands over the void, like Mario 64 or Spyro, run from the start to a flag in the north, with coins, three hidden stars, slimes to stomp and checkpoint flags. The hero is a man in a red cap and is never named; the words are a short HUD, notes, a signpost's hint and the end screen, in capitals, cheerful in tone.
